summary: Full end-to-end frontend testing of the re-architected vanilla-CSS 'Digitale Anamnese' PWA. Verified welcome page (German default, badge, 4 disclaimer bullets, start button 'Zu den Profilen'), language switcher (all 7 languages, Arabic RTL applied via document.dir=rtl, language persisted in localStorage under 'anamnesis_language' after reload), profile CRUD (create, select, rename via window.prompt, delete via ConfirmDialog modal - answers removed together, clear-all via danger-zone modal returns to welcome and wipes anamnesis_profiles/anamnesis_active_profile/anamnesis_answers_*), 8-section questionnaire with progress indicator ('Abschnitt X von 8' + percentage), all 6 field types (text/number/date/textarea/select/checkbox multi), required-field validation on beschwerden.mainComplaint blocks Next and shows inline error, per-profile isolation of answers (second profile starts empty), autosave to anamnesis_answers_<id> restores after full page reload, summary page shows 8 grouped section 'Bearbeiten' jump-back buttons and last-saved timestamp, JSON export downloads with correct schema (schemaVersion:'1.0', language, profile, savedAt, exportedAt, answers), and Print/PDF button present. No backend to test.

ui_bugs.issue: On 430px mobile viewport the profile list row (name + Auswählen + Umbenennen + Löschen) overflows horizontally, with the Löschen button partially cut off at the right edge. Row should wrap or stack on narrow viewports.

issues: Profile row action buttons overflow container on <=430px width

action_items: Make the ProfileSelector row responsive on mobile (flex-wrap or stack buttons under the profile name) so 'Löschen' is not clipped at 430px width.
critical_code_review_comments: storageService.clearAllData() does NOT remove the 'anamnesis_active_profile' key (only PROFILES_KEY and ANSWERS_PREFIX keys are collected). It happens to work in the UI because App.jsx also resets state, but on a subsequent reload the stale active profile id would still be in localStorage. Add ACTIVE_KEY to the keys collected in clearAllData(). Language key not being wiped is arguably fine (user's UI preference), but should be an intentional decision documented.

App.jsx currentSection is not reset when the user finishes the questionnaire and later navigates back via the header brand -> welcome -> profile -> continue; it is only reset in selectProfile and on the 'onContinue' button path (that path DOES reset to 0, so this is OK; noted for completeness).
QuestionField.jsx: help-text detection uses string equality against the key path; if a translation happens to equal the key, it would be shown. Low risk; document behavior.
No data-testid attributes anywhere (explicitly requested by client for thesis code cleanliness) — noted, tests rely on ids/text/classes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested user flows PASS (12/12 features)

seed_data_creation: Tests seeded and cleaned localStorage in-browser; no persistent data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 review-request features verified PASS on 430x900 mobile viewport against the deployed REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Only observed issue is a responsive layout clipping of the profile row's Löschen button on narrow screens, and a latent bug in storageService.clearAllData that leaves 'anamnesis_active_profile' in localStorage (masked by App.jsx state reset). Selectors that worked: '#lang-select', '.page button.btn--primary' (welcome/continue), 'button[type=submit]' (create profile), 'button.btn--danger.btn--block' + 'div.modal .btn--danger' (clear all confirm), 'button' has_text 'Löschen' / 'Umbenennen' / 'Auswählen', 'button:has-text(\'Weiter\')' and 'button:has-text(\'Zusammenfassung\')' for nav, '#q-<fieldId>' for inputs, '#q-chronicConditions-<opt>' for checkbox options. IMPORTANT gotcha: header brand button also contains the word 'Anamnese' — never use just has_text='Anamnese' for the continue button; scope with '.page button.btn--primary'.
